name: Golden Retrievers with Opinions
description: Recasts the existing protester kind as opinionated golden retrievers, with demands for open treats and transparent water bowls.

add.text: I support open treats. I oppose closed doors.
My position on fetch is clear: throw it again.
Water bowl transparency NOW. I can see the bottom.
Collective barking is a right. Belly rubs are a demand.
I have read the position paper. It tastes unconvincing.
The movement will resume after this very principled nap.
Golden retrievers stage a sit-in; organizers admit they already knew sit
United Pawposition demands open treats, longer walks, and accountable ball throwing
